feeds.title: Salvaged Inspirations Blog
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Denise. This blog shares my passion for furniture painting. Although I wasn't sure what direction it was going to take when I wrote my very first post, the SI Blog has turned into an online journal of before & afters, a resource for DIY furniture painting techniques, and documents my successes and failures along the way.

feeds.title: My Repurposed Life
feeds.description: Hi, there! I'm Gail Wilson, the author, and mastermind behind My Repurposed Life. My Repurposed Life is the place to find Repurposed Furniture and other household items. Whether it's a repurposed Dresser, Desk, or Nightstand, there's something to inspire everyone.

feeds.title: Dumped & Ditched Blog
feeds.description: Dumped & Ditched is about quality and artistry. We are passionate about preservation, sustainability, and second chances. By exclusively utilizing premium quality materials, we ensure your furniture will stand the test of time. All textiles in our extensive range are hand-picked, making sure they are of the highest standard and suited to the purpose.

feeds.title: I Restore Stuff Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sharon Hankins - a furniture painter & restorer who loves to upcycle and repurpose old, neglected pieces and give them a new lease on life. With over 10 year's experience in transforming old furniture items into must-have pieces for the home, I have the knowledge and passion to help you in your furniture restoration journey.

feeds.title: Lanciano Furniture Blog
feeds.description: Lanciano furniture is a family-owned and operated business for over 35 years. We are the finest and most efficient wood finishing experts. We have built our reputation on hard work and being loyal to our customers. We are true professionals and pride ourselves on our craftsmanship, and the quality of our work

feeds.title: Austin Furniture Repair Blog
feeds.description: Austin Furniture Repair has been a full-service furniture repair, refinishing & restoration center located in Austin Texas. We offer a service team squad of some of the best technicians and craftsmen, well-experienced in all kinds of furniture services. Our team abides by the commitment and passion for its work and believes in the blending of traditional knowledge synchronized with modern-age techniques.

feeds.title: Marina's Crafts Blog
feeds.description: Our services might be varied, but they all come with the same promise of quality, dedication, and craftsmanship. Marinas' Crafts has more than 20 years of experience working with furniture and wood. We have been serving in the Bay Area around 7 years and made tons of clients happy.

feeds.title: Furniture Medic Restoration Blog
feeds.description: Furniture Medic by MasterCare Experts in Carol Stream, IL provides a range of furniture repair and restoration services to the western Chicago suburbs. Our highly skilled craftsmen work on-site to repair or restore all types of furniture for much less than the cost of replacing your furniture. The furniture refinishing and repair services we offer include wood furniture refinishing, kitchen cabinet refinishing, antique furniture restoration, hardwood floor refinishing, and disaster restoration for commercial and residential settings.

feeds.title: Foxwood Restorations Blog
feeds.description: Foxwood Restoration is an insurance claim specialist when it comes to navigating through your homeowner's insurance loss. Foxwood Restorations specializes in furniture restoration including; furniture refinishing, furniture repairs, furniture stripping and sanding, as well as, furniture upholstery.

feeds.title: KRay Custom Refinish Blog
feeds.description: I'm KRay, the owner of KRay Custom Refinish and creator of one-of-a-kind, refinished furniture pieces of beauty. Here you will find the furniture restoration blog filled with helpful posts on Furniture Repairs, Wood Staining, Sanding, Chalk Painting, Distressing Paint, and more!

feeds.title: Metal Furniture Doctor Blog
feeds.description: Here at Metal Furniture Doctor, we make your old outdoor furniture look good as new through our restoration process. We specialize in refurbishing aluminum furniture, click below to see photographic examples of the types of furniture we can readily refurbish.

feeds.title: Antique World Blog
feeds.description: Antiques World is a website designed to display fine quality antiques including antique furniture constructed from the finest quality timbers. Antiques World is owned by Driscolls Antiques ltd who specializes in high-quality British antique furniture and unique antique collectibles. We have been established for over 30 years and during this time have developed the best restoration techniques we use to clean and restore using traditional methods bringing the original finish back to its former glory.

feeds.title: Better Than New Blog
feeds.description: Better Than New was formed in 1998 by Dan Oldejans in a small apartment in Scottsdale, AZ. We pride ourselves on taking on the challenges of a project and finding creative, efficient solutions. Our attention to detail is present throughout the project, from start to finish.

feeds.title: Kilmister Furniture Restoration Blog
feeds.description: At Kilmister Furniture Restoration, we believe in forever furniture. Our mission is to bring your beloved antiques and furniture back to life. Every piece has a story to tell. And now, more than ever, it's important to reuse and repurpose instead of filling up landfills

feeds.title: Carrocel Blog
feeds.description: At Carrocel, we are passionate about furniture. From high-end vintage selections spanning a variety of styles to custom-made pieces built to suit your specific needs and taste, we value the craftsmanship and design that goes into each item.

feeds.title: Americajun Furniture Solutions Blog
feeds.description: I am a professional woodworker that specializes in different types of woodwork. My shop is in Slaughter, Louisiana, but I make deliveries throughout the United States. My primary goal is to deliver exceptional craftsmanship to my clients. I pride myself on being reliable, on time, and delivering high-quality work. Woodwork is an art form; my job is to make my client's vision a reality through my work.
